items.label: Bar Cabinet with Wine Cooler (Fridge Included)
items.value: Measuring 47.2" W x 15.7" D x 30.7" H, this large capacity coffee bar fits mini fridges up to 15.3"W x 15.3"D x 21.6"H. Ideal for both storage and showcasing your favorite wine collection, eye-catching focal point in any space.

items.label: Ingenious Space Layout
items.value: Equipped with 9 wine racks, 2 glass holders, drawers, visual doors, extra storage cabinet, and fridge storage space, this farmhouse liquor cabinet keeps everything organized from bottles to glassware, kitchenware and more.

items.label: Infusing Modern Elegance
items.value: This long wine bar cabinet with mini refrigerator thoughtfully designed with a tabletop crafted from high-quality wood panels, adds a unique visual texture to your space. Three color LED lights (blue light, warm light and cold light) creating a cozy ambiance.

items.label: Versatile for Any Setting
items.value: Perfect as a beverage wine bar, coffee station, console table, or buffet sideboard, whether in your kitchen, living room, or home bar area. Also ideal for restaurants or cafés needing decorative and function in one piece.

items.label: Easy Assembly & Support
items.value: This black bar cabinet with storage made of FSC-Certified wood. And come with clear instructions and tools. Please notes: the alcohl cabinet come in with 2 packages, which may not necessarily arrive on the same day. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
